voice.name: Nicolas - French accent & cozy whisper
voice.why: A gentle, near-whispering French voice for Colin Brisset, the watch mender who hears every secret: the hush of a man passing on a rumor. Used by no other NPC.

greet.text: Psst. Come closer. Odilon talks too loud, and the walls on this square have ears.

town.text: Everybody on the square owes somebody. The trick is knowing who, and never saying it before noon.

barn.text: The old still barn. Odilon says it is empty at night. It is not. Ask at the cafe, and watch who goes quiet.

more.text: Oh, I have plenty. Choose one, and I will whisper it.

bell.text: The bell is two minutes slow, and has been since spring. I would fix it, but then what would I complain about?

courier.text: Buy the Courier and read the robbery story twice. Tuesday night, and not one word about the open window.

mine.text: The coal men come into town black to the elbows and spend every dollar by Friday. Lovely tippers.

market.text: At the market, the woman with the plums waters down her cider. Buy the apples. Trust the apples.

hostel.text: The hostel clerk keeps your key warm and your business to himself. A rare thing in this town.

who.text: Colin Brisset. I mend watches, and every secret in Saint-Philippe is wound a little too tight for my liking.

again.text: Was there something else? I am all ears, and not much else.

bye.text: Go on, then. And if anyone asks, you heard none of this from me.

replies.town: What do people say about the town?
